Palestinian factions are meeting in Egypt to discuss the future of Gaza, including the disarmament of Hamas and the transition to the second phase of the ceasefire agreement.

recent_articles.title: Smart Border Project Is In Final Stage, Says Amit Shah
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** announced the rollout of **Smart Border** pilot projects across India's international frontiers to address evolving security challenges, including drone-based smuggling and human trafficking. The program will integrate district administrations, police authorities, and local institutions into a coordinated security mechanism.  Shah emphasized that lasting border security requires participation from all stakeholders and highlighted the government's commitment to strengthening infrastructure and modernizing fencing systems. He also stressed the importance of environmental protection as a mass movement and praised BSF personnel for their dedication in challenging conditions.

recent_articles.title: Iran footballers issued US visas for World Cup, says White House | World Cup 2026 News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Iran’s** World Cup football players have been granted US visas, just 10 days before their opening match against New Zealand in Los Angeles. **US Ambassador to Turkiye Tom Barrack** confirmed the visas on X, stating that the team's road to the **FIFA World Cup** has been facilitated by the U.S. Embassy in Ankara. While some members of the Iranian team’s technical and administrative staff have not yet received their visas, the US has not officially stated its opposition to the team staying on its territory. The move comes amidst a tense geopolitical climate between the two countries, with Iran's presence at the World Cup serving as a symbol of peace efforts despite ongoing tensions.

recent_articles.title: Moderate quake hits Himachal districts; tremors felt in neighbouring States - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 5.0 magnitude earthquake struck near the Kangra-Chamba border in Himachal Pradesh on Friday night, causing tremors felt in parts of Punjab, Haryana, and Chandigarh. The epicenter was located near Dhar Godoi in Kangra, with a depth of 5 km.  **The meteorological office** reported that the tremor occurred at 10:04 pm and caused residents to evacuate their homes in panic. No injuries or significant damage have been reported so far.

recent_articles.title: Britain’s only serving female Royal Navy Commando among 3 killed in helicopter crash
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Three Royal Navy personnel, including **Lieutenant Lily-Mae Fisher**, Britain's only serving female Royal Navy Commando, were killed when a Merlin helicopter crashed during a training exercise in Devon. The helicopter went down near Dartmoor on Wednesday morning and an investigation is underway to determine the cause of the crash.  **Lieutenant Commander Chris Gayson** and **Petty Officer Owen Green** were also killed in the accident. Defence Secretary **John Healey** described the three as "dedicated and highly valued members of their squadrons."
